A bill for an act relating to agriculture; appropriating money for a grant to CelluComp.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated to the Department of Agriculture for a grant to CelluComp to support the commercialization of an innovative material additive that enables the production of fiber-based barrier packaging to reduce perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) and plastics in packaging products. This is a onetime appropriation and available until July 1, 2027. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; appropriating money for a grant to CelluComp.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated to the Department of Agriculture for a grant to CelluComp to support the commercialization of an innovative material additive that enables the production of fiber-based barrier packaging to reduce perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) and plastics in packaging products. This is a onetime appropriation and available until July 1, 2027.
additions: $10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated to the Department of Agriculture for a grant to CelluComp to support the commercialization of an innovative material additive that enables the production of fiber-based barrier packaging to reduce perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) and plastics in packaging products. This is a onetime appropriation and available until July 1, 2027.
